title.zh: 【Chainlink 推出 CCIP Vault Adapters，支持跨 80 余条链一键存款】
title.en: 【Chainlink 推出 CCIP Vault Adapters，支持跨 80 余条链一键存款】

current_state.zh: Chainlink launched CCIP Vault Adapters, enabling single-network DeFi vaults (initially ERC-4626) to receive deposits from over 80 blockchains without per-chain redeployment, with Aave, Lombard, Venus, Veda and World Liberty Financial already adopting it.
current_state.en: Chainlink launched CCIP Vault Adapters, enabling single-network DeFi vaults (initially ERC-4626) to receive deposits from over 80 blockchains without per-chain redeployment, with Aave, Lombard, Venus, Veda and World Liberty Financial already adopting it.
